question.why: No promise reported a vote, so proposer 8 was free to propose bravo, and acceptor 3 kept its own promise. Acceptor 2 broke the rule: its vote for alpha was gone, so the two majorities met at an acceptor with no memory.

beats.says: A majority that forgets its vote is no longer a majority. So an acceptor keeps its disk, and paros refuses to boot a member whose disk is empty.
